name: Voxel Neighbor Activation Check
definition: A method to determine which of the 6 adjacent voxels (neighbors) are active/solid for a given voxel at (x, y, z), considering both internal chunk data and external heightmap boundaries.
summary: Voxel Neighbor Activation Check determines voxel solidity by querying internal arrays for neighbors within chunk bounds and external heightmaps for those crossing boundaries.
